name: Truffle Tagliatelle with Parmigiano
steps: Bring a large pot of salted water to a boil. Cook tagliatelle until 1 min before al dente. Reserve a cup of pasta water before draining.
While pasta cooks, melt butter in a wide pan over very low heat — do not let it brown.
Shave half the truffle directly into the butter and warm for 1 min off the heat to infuse.
Add drained pasta to the pan with 3–4 tbsp of pasta water. Toss vigorously over low heat until a glossy sauce forms.
Remove from heat, add half the grated Parmigiano and toss again, adding more pasta water if needed.
Plate immediately and finish with remaining Parmigiano and freshly shaved truffle.
